G1_unambiguity.justification: The cross-product condition is precisely defined, and the input, output, lexicographic rule, and feasibility requirement admit only one reasonable interpretation.

G2_completeness.justification: All necessary bounds, input formats, multiplier values, pair constraints, output formats, and tie-breaking rules are provided.

G3_faithfulness.justification: Since two vectors of the form (1, f, f²) have zero cross product exactly when their multipliers are equal, the rewritten task is exactly the original three-coloring task with the same bounds and lexicographic output requirement.

G4_naturalness.justification: The statement is coherent and readable, although the invented relay and resonant-loop terminology is more elaborate than necessary for a simple graph-coloring problem.
